verdicts.reason: Neither rearranges anything. Both keep the original narrow centred column on a wide banner and leave large empty white areas on the left and right. A's text is larger and easier to read, but its address row sits right against the bottom of the photo with no gap. The stray glyph marks in 'Glen Elder' and 'Kansas' remain. B has better spacing around the photo, but its headline sits visibly left of the photo's centre, and its small subhead and address are weak at this size.
